summary.text: Terry Cummings, a Democrat, represents Georgia House District 39; the General Assembly's member page lists her occupation as attorney and her residence as Mableton.

paragraphs.text: In a 2022 Cobb County Courier interview, Cummings said she was born in New York, raised in Teaneck, New Jersey, and attended Rutgers University's Douglass College.
Cummings said she worked at DC Superior Court, attended law school at night, and then joined the U.S. Department of Justice's Honors Attorney Program at the Federal Bureau of Prisons.

sources.title: Q & A with Terry Cummings, Democratic hopeful for GA State House District 39
